compute_tax.lines: list of (category: str, amount_cents: int) for ALL order lines; tax.py itself skips categories listed in exempt_categories.csv
compute_tax.region: customer region string (e.g. TX). None means unknown customer -> returns 0. A non-None region not in rates.csv raises KeyError
compute_tax.discount_pct: customer discount in percent (e.g. 10 for 10%); default 0
compute_tax.returns: tax amount in integer cents, rounded half up

why: invoice.py passes line categories and amounts plus customer region/discount from pricing.py; tax.py owns all tax rules, so exemption and rounding stay in tax.py
agent3 accepts tax_api v1 (compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) -> int cents).
